independentSourceAudit.native_scope: Read display/window geometry and DPI; reposition this application window with SetWindowPos. No hardware, OEM, SDK, IPC, service, firmware, network, registry, or permission operation added.
placement_review: Startup explicitly ignores prior saved Maximized state and opens normal; native maximize remains unrestricted.
First monitor comes from cursor position with HWND fallback; later fits use the current HWND monitor.
GetMonitorInfo WorkArea excludes taskbar and preserves signed desktop origins; native placement stays in physical pixels.
Only desired DIP sizes are scaled. GetDpiForWindow is used when available, with WPF TransformToDevice fallback for early Windows 10.
Compact default is 750 by 565 DIP, about two thirds of 1120 by 850 DIP, with unchanged font sizes and scrollable content.
At 250 percent scale in a 3200 by 1720 physical-pixel work area, pure placement yields 1875 by 1413 physical pixels at (662,153).
Minimum size is reduced to available work area in DIP; no MaxWidth or MaxHeight prevents maximizing.
DPI, display and settings changes queue fitting at ContextIdle after WPF; active move/resize defers correction.
Same-DPI monitor transitions are detected by comparing HWND monitor at enter/exit move-size.
Fits skip minimized and maximized states; normal restore queues a fit; valid user position and dimensions are preserved.
Closing removes native hook and queued callbacks check closed/shutdown state.
Pure arithmetic validates finite positive scales, nonempty rectangles and representable signed edges.
guidance_review: Folder feedback is separate display metadata and preserves save filenames, save errors and duplicate-save markers.
Folder command keeps the existing interaction service and does not invoke hardware/manual operations.
Cancellation and diagnostic wording changes do not change manual-state or cleanup gates.
Version changes are confined to ApplicationRelease display/file constants, with no protocol change.

The Samsung file diagnostic failure caption is also scoped to that diagnostic; the added fake-provider regression preserves manual result identity, gates, receipt and operation counts without a save or exception leak.
validation_limits: Static source review and pure placement expectations do not verify actual Windows nonclient rendering, native message timing or mixed-monitor behavior.
